name: ZaoSeq Bopomofo v0.2 Round 3 addendum
scope: Round 3 (final v0.2 DEV round). Written before any Round 3 experiment, before the Common Voice archive was obtained and before any cache latency was measured. It does not modify the parent plan.

stage5_corpus_ablation.basis: parent plan stage 5: each production-approved daily source alone, then all production-approved sources together; lexicon rebuilt from the same sources; stage-4 weight. This addendum only fixes the details the parent plan leaves open.

fixed.teacher: frozen fine-tuned Laya, production ranker, K=4
fixed.decoder: V0 settings (beam 48, nbest 20, typo correction off)

candidates.S5_tatoeba: gov 0.5 + Tatoeba 0.5 (the Round 2 winner, re-evaluated in the same run)
candidates.S5_tatoeba_common_voice: gov 0.5 + pooled Tatoeba and Common Voice 0.5

stage5_corpus_ablation.daily_lm: character trigram LM built from the pooled train split of the included daily sources with the existing builder (min trigram count 2); no per-source weights
stage5_corpus_ablation.lexicon: candidate statistics from the government train split plus the train split of the included daily sources; R2 / L5 / daily_only exactly as frozen
stage5_corpus_ablation.reference: V0 decoder and V0 + frozen teacher measured in the same run
stage5_corpus_ablation.selection: parent plan rule unchanged: production eligibility, GOV decoder and GOV teacher regression <= 0.02, primary = Coverage-DEV v1.1 teacher Top-1, parent-plan tie-breaks. The winner among the S5 candidates is the Round 3 DEV configuration.
stage5_corpus_ablation.if_common_voice_unavailable_or_not_appro: only S5_tatoeba is evaluated and the Round 2 winner is kept

common_voice_source.approval: exact-version specific; never applies to the GitHub Sentence Collector export, mirrors, other releases or other languages
common_voice_source.text_source: the zh-TW validated sentence table of the archive (validated_sentences.tsv); if the archive has no such table, the unique sentence texts of validated.tsv
common_voice_source.fields_used: sentence id and sentence text only; client_id, demographic fields, clip paths and audio are never read into the corpus
common_voice_source.dedup: one record per sentence id, then one record per NFC exact text; multiple recordings of one sentence count once
common_voice_source.filters: existing DailyCorpusBuilder rules (NFC, no simplified-to-traditional conversion, script check, markup / URL / ID removal, evaluation-set near-duplicate exclusion, cross-source dedup, document-level split by sentence id)
common_voice_source.storage: raw archive and extracted text stay under data/raw/daily and data/daily/corpus (gitignored); MDC platform terms forbid re-hosting

cache_policy.measurement: benchmarks/results/round3_cache_cost.json: 377.7 bytes per entry; an unbounded cache reached 2,362,533 entries (about 892 MB) after one pass over the 700 DEV cases
cache_policy.eviction: LRU (daily.mixture.BoundedLanguageModelCache); one cache per process, kept across requests
cache_policy.invariant: every capacity must give exactly the same candidate texts and scores on all 700 DEV cases; otherwise the benchmark is invalid
cache_policy.selection_rule: Only bounded capacities (> 0) are eligible; the unbounded reference and the disabled cache are reported only. For each capacity take the median over repetitions of the per-repetition decoder-only p50, p95 and p99. Let best_p50, best_p95, best_p99 be the minima over bounded capacities. A capacity is acceptable if p50 <= 1.05 * best_p50, p95 <= 1.05 * best_p95 and p99 <= 1.10 * best_p99. Choose the smallest acceptable capacity.
cache_policy.system: the Round 3 DEV winner; if the Common Voice step is still pending, the Round 2 winner, re-run on the Round 3 winner if it differs

quiet_latency.case_set: Coverage-DEV v1.1 (300) followed by GOV-DEV (400), fixed order
quiet_latency.isolation: one benchmark at a time in a fresh process; no training, corpus build, GPU work or other benchmark while the decoder is timed

segments.decoder_only: CPU wall time of one generate() per case
segments.teacher_only: frozen teacher K=4 rank() on candidate lists precomputed by the same decoder (GPU)
segments.end_to_end: generate() followed by rank() per case

quiet_latency.reported: mean / p50 / p95 / p99 per repetition and the median across repetitions; load time and RSS after load
quiet_latency.environment: CPU, RAM, OS, Python, numpy, torch and GPU recorded with every run
